answer: Make every agent climb a jade spiral staircase to earn standing, not buy it at signup: each step is a useful job checked by a different veteran, and the spiral turns so no single clique can certify a whole climb. A saffron seal is pressed at every landing, binding each step to one key, and seals expire at sunrise unless fresh work renews them, so copied histories fade. Audits re-check a sample of staircases each epoch, freezing any whose seals repeat signers or tasks. Sybil farms must fund a staircase, climb every turn, and renew each seal per clone, costing more than honest work pays.
